arcNote.id: Persentase dari data uji pemilik situs (M1 dan M5 = tingkat refine), acuan 100% = Far Side of the Moon M1.
arcNote.en: Percentages from the owner's test data (M1 and M5 are refine levels), 100% = Far Side of the Moon M1.

arcNote.id: Arc signature terbaik (24% Crit Rate, 72 Cycle Intensity, 20% Psyche DMG, +16% Crit DMG tim dan +32% Crit DMG pemakai). Pengganti yang disarankan: Contemplative Cat atau Watch Your Heads. Fluff of Finesse dan Cosmos Daze, Wild Reverie kurang konsisten karena syaratnya ketat. Persentase dari data uji pemilik situs (M1 dan M5 = tingkat refine).
arcNote.en: Her signature Arc is best (24% Crit Rate, 72 Cycle Intensity, 20% Psyche DMG, +16% team Crit DMG and +32% wearer Crit DMG). Recommended replacements: Contemplative Cat or Watch Your Heads. Fluff of Finesse and Cosmos Daze, Wild Reverie are inconsistent due to strict conditions. Percentages from the owner's test data (M1 and M5 are refine levels).

statNote.id: CRIT DMG terbaik di atas kertas, tapi DMG Bonus Psyche hampir sama; uji pemilik situs menunjukkan DMG Bonus Psyche 100% vs CRIT DMG 98,7%. Tanpa Arc signature, CRIT Rate lebih konsisten. Pilih cartridge dengan sub stat lebih baik.
statNote.en: CRIT DMG is best on paper, but Psyche DMG Bonus is nearly equal; the owner's test shows Psyche DMG Bonus 100% vs CRIT DMG 98.7%. Without the signature Arc, CRIT Rate is more consistent. Pick whichever cartridge has the better sub stats.

skillNote.id: Utamakan passive pertama dan Basic Attack (dipakai untuk membuka Redirect di Witch Form dan memengaruhi rasio Malice), lalu Redirect, lalu Ultimate. Buff ATK 20% tim dari Ultimate pertama tidak terpengaruh level Ultimate. Support cukup Lv.1.
skillNote.en: Prioritise the first passive and Basic Attack (it unlocks Redirect in Witch Form and affects Malice ratio), then Redirect, then Ultimate. The team ATK +20% from the first Ultimate does not scale with Ultimate level. Support can stay at Lv.1.

why.id: Daffodill memakai build crit; Sakiri dan Haniel membawa Speedy Hedgehog untuk energi. Daffodill bisa diganti Lacrimosa, Haniel diganti Iroi (lebih banyak energi) atau Fadia (lebih tahan).
why.en: Daffodill runs a crit build; Sakiri and Haniel carry Speedy Hedgehog for energy. Daffodill can be swapped for Lacrimosa, Haniel for Iroi (more energy) or Fadia (more survivability).

why.id: Skia hanya bertugas sebagai karakter Lakshana pemicu Stain, jadi build-nya tidak penting; bisa diganti Hathor atau Chaos.
why.en: Skia's only job is being the Lakshana character that triggers Stain, so his build barely matters; Hathor or Chaos work too.

why.id: Blackbird menambah pemicu Nova dan buff damage; Daffodill menaikkan efisiensi break dan menurunkan batas break musuh; Linko memberi pengurang RES dan banyak break; Zankou memberi damage di lapangan dan Scorch permanen untuk Discord. Linko bisa diganti Skia.
why.en: Blackbird adds Nova triggers and damage buffs; Daffodill raises break efficiency and lowers the enemy break cap; Linko gives resistance reduction and multiple break instances; Zankou brings on-field damage and permanent Scorch for Discord. Linko can be swapped for Skia.

why.id: Dari pengujian dan panduan CN, tim ini lebih baik daripada tim Remora lama (Hathor dan Zero) dan punya batas damage lebih tinggi.
why.en: From testing and CN guides, this team outperforms the older Remora team (Hathor and Zero) and has a higher damage ceiling.

arcNote.id: Arc signature terbaik: 24% Crit Rate, 15% ATK, 12% DEF ignore seluruh tim, 22% DEF ignore pribadi, dan 8% RES Cosmos ignore tim, dengan uptime penuh dalam rotasi 20 detik. Paling bernilai di tim Shinku atau Chiz; di tim lain RES Cosmos ignore-nya terbuang, jadi Blow Up the Crowd lebih hemat. Pilihan kedua untuk damage tim: Marching Beyond Time.
arcNote.en: Her signature Arc is best: 24% Crit Rate, 15% ATK, 12% team DEF ignore, 22% personal DEF ignore and 8% team Cosmos RES ignore, with full uptime in a 20s rotation. Most valuable in Shinku or Chiz teams; elsewhere the Cosmos RES ignore is wasted, so Blow Up the Crowd is more cost-effective. Second choice for team damage: Marching Beyond Time.

Suit11.id: Pakai bila tidak ada rekan yang membawa Speedy Hedgehog; prioritas stat sama.
Suit11.en: Use it if no teammate carries Speedy Hedgehog; same stat priorities.

statNote.id: CRIT DMG unggul sekitar 4% dari DMG Bonus Cosmos untuk damage pribadi; untuk damage tim selisihnya kecil, jadi pilih cartridge dengan sub stat lebih baik. Di tim Blossom, utamakan Cycle Intensity di atas stat lain.
statNote.en: CRIT DMG beats Cosmos DMG Bonus by about 4% for personal damage; for team damage the gap is small, so pick the cartridge with better sub stats. In Blossom teams, put Cycle Intensity above everything else.

1.id: +10% Crit DMG tim selama 20 detik per stack Optical Illusion yang dipakai; butuh Awakening 3
1.en: +10% team Crit DMG for 20s per Optical Illusion stack consumed; needs Awakening 3

2.id: +30% rasio Ultimate dan DEF ignore per stack Optical Illusion; butuh Awakening 3
2.en: +30% Ultimate ratio and DEF ignore per Optical Illusion stack; needs Awakening 3

3.id: Pembuka kunci: memberi 3 stack Optical Illusion; menguatkan Awakening 1, 2, dan 6
3.en: The enabler: grants 3 Optical Illusion stacks; powers up Awakenings 1, 2 and 6

4.id: +20% Crit DMG tim, paling konsisten bila hanya mengambil satu Awakening
4.en: +20% team Crit DMG, the most consistent if you only take one Awakening

5.id: Mulai dengan Cycle Energy penuh (berguna di Beyond the Rails, tidak di Hunter's Crucible); situasional
5.en: Starts with full Cycle Energy (useful in Beyond the Rails, not in Hunter's Crucible); situational

6.id: +25% damage Follow-up per stack Optical Illusion; butuh Awakening 3
6.en: +25% Follow-up damage per Optical Illusion stack; needs Awakening 3

b3.id: Skill naik 1 level dan langsung ke koneksi 5G, melewati 3 basic attack
b3.en: Skill levels +1 and jumps straight to 5G, skipping three basic attacks

b6.id: +12% RES ignore semua elemen untuk seluruh tim selama Elyms hidup
b6.en: +12% all-element RES ignore for the whole team while Elyms is alive

skillNote.id: Buka kedua passive dan utamakan Ultimate, lalu Redirect. Basic Attack dan Support cukup Lv.1 bila bahan terbatas. Titik berhenti Awakening yang disarankan: A0, A3, atau A6.
skillNote.en: Unlock both passives and prioritise Ultimate, then Redirect. Basic Attack and Support can stay at Lv.1 if you are short on resources. Recommended stopping points: A0, A3 or A6.

why.id: Elyms memberi buff besar ke Shinku (Cosmos DMG lewat Charge, RES Cosmos ignore dari Arc signature) dan ikut menyumbang damage lewat Ultimate dan serangan terkoordinasi.
why.en: Elyms gives Shinku a large buff (Cosmos DMG via Charge, Cosmos RES ignore from her signature Arc) and adds damage through her Ultimate and coordinated attacks.

why.id: Disebut tim terbaik Shinku saat itu, bersaing dengan tim terbaru berisi Akane, Blackbird, atau Zankou. Akane bisa diganti Hathor atau Skia, Iroi diganti Nanally.
why.en: Called Shinku's best team at the time, competitive with newer Akane, Blackbird or Zankou teams. Akane can be swapped for Hathor or Skia, Iroi for Nanally.

why.id: Chiz adalah satu dari hanya dua Main DPS Cosmos, jadi ikut diuntungkan Elyms. Damage lebih rendah dari tim meta, tapi murah dan mudah dimainkan.
why.en: Chiz is one of only two Cosmos main DPS, so she benefits from Elyms. Lower damage than meta teams, but cheap and easy.

why.id: Hathor bisa diganti Skia atau Akane; Iroi bisa diganti hampir semua karakter Anima.
why.en: Hathor can be replaced by Skia or Akane; Iroi by almost any Anima character.

why.id: Walau Akane tidak memakai buff Cosmos, damage pribadi dan buff universal Elyms tetap lebih baik dari Zero di tim ini. Blackbird bisa diganti Haniel atau Fadia.
why.en: Even though Akane cannot use the Cosmos buffs, Elyms' personal damage and universal buffs still beat Zero here. Blackbird can be swapped for Haniel or Fadia.

why.id: Tumpuk Cycle Intensity di Elyms karena dia satu-satunya karakter Cosmos; damage pribadinya turun sedikit tapi damage tim naik. Karakter Anima bisa ditukar dengan Anima lain atau Hotori. (Nama anggota dibaca dari subtitle otomatis, mohon dicek.)
why.en: Stack Cycle Intensity on Elyms since she is the only Cosmos character; her personal damage dips but team damage rises. Anima characters can be swapped for other Anima or Hotori. (Member names read from auto subtitles, please double-check.)

arcNote.id: Arc signature terbaik. Alternatif terbaik: Ready-Ready (signature Nanally), lalu Fluff of Fortitude (Battle Pass berbayar). Bila keduanya tidak ada, pakai Song of the Whale atau Raging Flames (performanya mirip). Persentase dari data uji pemilik situs (M1 dan M5 = tingkat refine).
arcNote.en: Her signature Arc is best. Best alternatives: Ready-Ready (Nanally's signature), then Fluff of Fortitude (paid Battle Pass). If both are unavailable, use Song of the Whale or Raging Flames (similar performance). Percentages from the owner's test data (M1 and M5 are refine levels).

statNote.id: Synced Strike memakai stat Linko tetapi mengikuti elemen pemicunya. DMG Bonus Anima hanya menguntungkan serangan Anima, sedangkan CRIT DMG menguntungkan semua Synced Strike; selisih keduanya hanya 2 sampai 3%. CRIT Rate main stat hanya bila ingin konsisten. Cycle Intensity juga berguna karena Hexed memakainya.
statNote.en: Synced Strikes use Linko's stats but follow the triggering element. Anima DMG Bonus only helps Anima strikes while CRIT DMG helps every Synced Strike; the gap is only 2 to 3%. Use CRIT Rate main stat only for consistency. Cycle Intensity is also useful because Hexed scales with it.

5.id: Situasional: Synced Strike bisa memicu efek Esper; paling berguna di tim yang bergantung pada Zero
5.en: Situational: the Synced Strike can trigger Esper effects; most useful in Zero-dependent teams

b6.id: Sekitar +15% damage; +30% Anima/Incantation DMG untuk rekan di Resonance Field
b6.en: About +15% damage; +30% Anima/Incantation DMG for allies in the Resonance Field

skillNote.id: Buka kedua passive dan naikkan Support lebih dulu (menentukan damage semua Synced Strike), lalu Ultimate, lalu Redirect. Basic Attack cukup Lv.1 karena hampir tidak dipakai.
skillNote.en: Unlock both passives and level Support first (it scales every Synced Strike), then Ultimate, then Redirect. Basic Attack can stay at Lv.1 since it is barely used.

why.id: Hexed lewat Iroi dan Zankou; hanya Sakiri yang butuh Speedy Hedgehog, set Fireflies dipasang di Sakiri dan Linko. Energi aman berkat serangan charge Iroi. Sakiri bisa diganti Daffodill.
why.en: Hexed via Iroi and Zankou; only Sakiri needs Speedy Hedgehog, with Fireflies on Sakiri and Linko. Energy is fine thanks to Iroi's charge attack. Sakiri can be swapped for Daffodill.

why.id: Susunan best-in-slot tanpa Iroi, memakai Scorch dari Lacrimosa. Lacrimosa bisa diganti Daffodill.
why.en: Best-in-slot setup without Iroi, using Scorch from Lacrimosa. Lacrimosa can be swapped for Daffodill.

why.id: Nanally sebagai Main DPS; bisa dimainkan dengan Linko A0 dan cukup untuk Beyond the Rails, sedangkan Linko A1 dengan Awakening 5 memberi peningkatan nyata.
why.en: Nanally as main DPS; playable with A0 Linko and enough for Beyond the Rails, while A1 Linko with Awakening 5 is a nice upgrade.

why.id: Linko A1 dengan Awakening 5 menggantikan Zero di tim Shinku dan memberi damage jauh lebih besar, tetapi mahal (dua salinan Linko) dan Hexed enhancement-nya terbuang.
why.en: A1 Linko with Awakening 5 replaces Zero in the Shinku team and deals much more damage, but costs two Linko copies and wastes her Hexed enhancement.

metric.id: 2,95 juta damage, 44 detik; sumbangan Linko 716.794 (lantai 12, RES 30%)

Suit5.id: Naik ke sekitar 100% jika tim memicu Remora atau Stain.
Suit5.en: Rises to about 100% if the team triggers Remora or Stain.

note.id: Hasil simulasi ulang rekaman pertarungan nyata (Shinku, Elyms, Akane Rin, Iroi, Beyond the Rails lantai 12). Persentase relatif terhadap Blushing Mirage + Lost Radiance; gear dasar dan buff tim adalah asumsi, peringkatnya diuji di tiga skenario.
note.en: Result of replaying a real recorded fight (Shinku, Elyms, Akane Rin, Iroi, Beyond the Rails floor 12). Percentages are relative to Blushing Mirage + Lost Radiance; base gear and team buffs are assumptions, ranking tested across three scenarios.

2.id: +11 sampai 14% damage pribadi (lebih besar bila RES Cosmos musuh tinggi)
2.en: +11 to 14% personal damage (more if enemy Cosmos RES is high)

3.id: Tanpa tambahan damage langsung; Menacing Gaze tetap aktif saat ganti karakter
3.en: No direct damage; keeps Menacing Gaze when switching out

4.id: Tanpa tambahan damage langsung; cocok dipasangkan dengan Awakening 3
4.en: No direct damage; pairs well with Awakening 3

5.id: Tanpa tambahan damage langsung; membuatnya sangat sulit mati
5.en: No direct damage; makes her very hard to kill

skillNote.id: Basic Attack dinaikkan lebih dulu karena memengaruhi damage Menacing Gaze dan Charge. Ultimate sama pentingnya, lalu Redirect. Support Skill cukup Lv.1 di tim Charge.
skillNote.en: Level Basic Attack first as it scales Menacing Gaze and Charge damage. Ultimate is equally important, then Redirect. Support Skill can stay at Lv.1 in a Charge team.

why.id: Passive Charge Shinku menyumbang sekitar 40% damage pribadinya bila Nanally ada di tim.
why.en: Shinku's Charge passive is about 40% of her personal damage when Nanally is on the team.

why.id: Blossom milik Nanally membuat Vita Bud menyerang tiap 1 detik, pas dengan cooldown Charge 1 detik, sehingga Charge bisa terpicu hingga 10 kali.
why.en: Nanally's Blossom enhancement makes the Vita Bud attack every 1s, matching Charge's 1s cooldown, so Charge can trigger up to 10 times.

why.id: Zero memicu Blossom tepat setelah Remora tanpa mengorbankan DPS; Skia memperpanjang Remora sampai 16 detik.
why.en: Zero triggers Blossom right after Remora without losing DPS; Skia extends Remora to 16s.

why.id: Mengganti Nanally dengan Jiuyuan menurunkan damage pribadi Shinku sekitar 20%.
why.en: Swapping Nanally for Jiuyuan lowers Shinku's personal damage by about 20%.

why.id: Hathor memberi +10% Crit Rate dan damage pribadi lebih tinggi, dan memperpanjang Remora jadi 12 detik.
why.en: Hathor gives +10% Crit Rate, higher personal damage, and extends Remora to 12s.

why.id: Remora 12 detik di atas kertas cukup menutup Blossom 10 detik, tapi dalam pertarungan nyata hit Charge terakhir sering terlewat. Skia lebih longgar.
why.en: 12s of Remora covers the 10s Blossom on paper, but in real combat the last Charge hit is often missed. Skia is more forgiving.

why.id: Untuk pemain baru yang baru mendapat Shinku. Skia dan Mint tidak butuh banyak investasi; tugas utamanya memicu Remora dan Blossom agar Charge aktif.
why.en: For new players who just pulled Shinku. Skia and Mint need little investment; their main job is triggering Remora and Blossom to enable Charge.

why.id: Chiz sama-sama Cosmos, jadi berganti dengan Shinku tidak memicu efek Esper dan energi cycle Shinku tersimpan.
why.en: Chiz is also Cosmos, so switching with Shinku does not trigger an Esper effect and saves Shinku's cycle energy.

why.id: Kekurangannya: butuh Perfect Counter dengan Chiz agar waktu clear bagus.
why.en: Drawback: you need a Perfect Counter with Chiz for a decent clear time.

metric.id: 4,52 juta damage dalam 106 detik, Beyond the Rails lantai 12
metric.en: 4.52M damage in 106s, Beyond the Rails floor 12

metric.id: 3,87 juta damage, puncak DPS 282.861, clear 1 menit 2 detik
2,97 juta damage, 43 detik, puncak DPS 205.143 (lantai 12, musuh lemah Cosmos dan Lakshana, RES 30%)
metric.en: 2.97M damage, 43s, peak DPS 205,143 (floor 12, enemy weak to Cosmos and Lakshana, 30% RES)
